April 30, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Dynamic Capital Management Ltd decreased its stake in Nike Inc (NKE) by 70.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dynamic Capital Management Ltd sold 26,600 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.55% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 11,000 shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $688,000, down from 37,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dynamic Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Nike Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $112.20 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.07% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $69.61. About 1.33M shares traded. NIKE, Inc. (NYSE:NKE) has risen 18.31% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.76% the S&P500.
Kessler Investment Group Llc increased its stake in Microsoft Corp (MSFT) by 18.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kessler Investment Group Llc bought 9,471 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.63% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 61,806 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.29 million, up from 52,335 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kessler Investment Group Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $734.82 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.19% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $95.64. About 8.44M shares traded. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) has risen 37.43% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.88% the S&P500.
Analysts await NIKE, Inc. (NYSE:NKE) to report earnings on July, 5. They expect $0.64 earnings per share, up 6.67% or $0.04 from last year’s $0.6 per share. NKE’s profit will be $1.03B for 27.19 P/E if the $0.64 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.68 actual earnings per share reported by NIKE, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -5.88% negative EPS growth.
Dynamic Capital Management Ltd, which manages about $932.59 million and $290.80M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Vodafone Group Plc New (NASDAQ:VOD) by 216,920 shares to 239,520 shares, valued at $7.64M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ecolab Inc (NYSE:ECL) by 7,435 shares in the quarter, for a total of 9,649 shares, and has risen its stake in Edison Intl (NYSE:EIX).
